assignedTasks.title: Baseline Performance Audit (Core Web Vitals)
assignedTasks.description:
Measure and document the LST app performance. Requirements:
1. FCP (First Contentful Paint) must be < 1000ms.
2. LCP (Largest Contentful Paint) must be < 1200ms.
3. Benchmark performance with and without blur effects on low-energy devices.

assignedTasks.title: Global Room Load Testing
assignedTasks.description:
Simulate concurrent users in the Global Room. Requirements:
1. Test backend response time under 100+ concurrent Socket.io connections.
2. Measure latency for message broadcasts.
3. Identify bottlenecks in MongoDB message retrieval.
